_comment: By-DOI rescue manifest, read by build-data.mjs (rescueMissingWorks) in every daily build. Papers listed or discovered here are fetched from Crossref BY DOI and folded into the harvest when the journal-route listing misses them. Per journal key: 'dois' = explicit bare DOIs (a DOI Crossref cannot resolve is reported and skipped — safe probe semantics; the batch filter=doi route is tried first, then a singular GET /works/<doi> per still-missing explicit DOI); 'scans' = {volume} specs resolved against OpenAlex each build. History: the vol-67 OpenAlex scan proved barren (OpenAlex mirrors Crossref's metadata hole — the 'missing' papers were in the catalog all along as frozen no-volume records, repaired via _aia-fixups.json); the 10.1287/mnsc.2014.1882 probe resolved as a bad citation, NOT a missing paper; and the three OR papers genuinely absent from the harvest (opre.2018.1783, .2018.1827, .2019.1870 — confirmed via the publisher TOCs) proved ABSENT FROM CROSSREF ENTIRELY (validated live 2026-08-03: the batch returned nothing and the singular GET 404s for all three), so they were moved to the _informs-aia.json supplement, which lands them from their TOC metadata with volume/issue/pages via _aia-fixups.json — keeping them here would just retry doomed 404s every build. All probes answered; the manifest is currently empty.
